params.body:
Closes #1087

The daily smoke test (`stocklist:smoke --all`, 06:30) stopped with exit 1 on 2026-11-11 (Nightwatch #73). The RealGarant line read:

```
token in 3073 ms; wagen #23924: ErrorException: Attempt to read property "kind" on false
```

## Cause

`VehicleRealGarantService::getPrograms` mapped over the answer of `getWarrantyPrograms()` with `$item->kind`. When RealGarant refuses, times out or answers with an error, that answer is `['success' => false, 'message' => ...]`, not a list, and its first element is `false`. This is the same shape as Nightwatch #41 (R S4-6.22), one call further: the vehicle search got a gate then, the programme list did not.

On the public warranty route that is a 500, since `RealGarantController` only catches `ConnectionException`. In the smoke test the line named an exception class instead of what RealGarant answered.

## Change

- `VehicleRealGarantService::programList` lets only a list of objects through (an empty list is still a valid answer). Anything else returns `success: false`, `fault: true` and RealGarant's own reason, so the warranty block hides like for any other failure.
- `IntegrationChecks`: a result with `fault` is a failure of the connection. The check stops at once (the list is the same for every vehicle) and puts RealGarant's reason in the line.
- Rule R S4-6.23 added, R P3-13.8 amended, finding `2026-11-11-een-fout-antwoord-op-de-programmalijst`.

## Tests

`AFailedProgramListIsNotAListTest`: the shapes that are not a programme list, the full `getPrograms` path with RealGarant timing out on the list, and the smoke verdict. Touched tests green (38); full suite run once before this proposal.

## After merge

Run `php artisan stocklist:smoke realgarant` on production. If RealGarant still fails, the line now says why in RealGarant's own words.

Source: Portal mail:48.
params.title: A failed RealGarant programme list is not a list of programmes
